title: Return Policy
content: Sapphire offers a 7-day return policy for all products. Items must be in original condition with tags attached. Return shipping costs are borne by the customer unless the item is defective.
details: Returns accepted within 7 days of delivery
Items must be unworn and in original packaging
Original receipt or order confirmation required

title: Exchange Policy
content: Exchanges are available for size and color changes within 7 days of purchase. The item must be in original condition with all tags attached.
details: Items must be in original condition

title: Shipping Policy
content: Sapphire offers nationwide shipping across Pakistan. Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express delivery available in major cities.
details: Free shipping on orders above PKR 3,000
